tags.name: Waveform
tags.description: WFDB waveform decoding from the bucket

get.summary: Decode a slice of a WFDB record from the bucket. filename is bucket-relative (with or without .hea); offset and range are seconds, range at most 600.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start, in seconds from the record start

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Length, in seconds; values above 600 are capped

200.description: Decoded slice: StartTime, OffsetInSec, TicksPerSec, SamplesPerChannel, TotalSamples, DurationSec, WaveformData[]

400.description: Missing/invalid parameter, or a path outside the bucket

422.description: Decoder failed on the record (unreadable or corrupt)

502.description: Decoder returned output that is not JSON
